content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to use the same input in different places throughout the program? For instance, I use input I1 at the start of my program, and then I want to use it again at a different section. Is extending a line across the entire diagram the only solution here? Thanks!

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. You can reference an input multiple times in your project, whether it's a real or virtual input. However, the block is only placed once within the diagram. If you need to use the block both at the start and end of the diagram, the connection must go the whole length, creating a long line. To organize your diagram, you can use the 'Separate' function to split lines, and the 'Join' function to reconnect separated sections. Please see the attached video for more details.
Or were you referring to something else?

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are looking to reuse the same input in multiple sections of a program developed using a graphical interface. Their main concern is how to avoid messy or lengthy lines on the diagram and whether there are more efficient or visually clear solutions for referencing inputs multiple times.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to reference inputs several times within their program without creating cluttered diagrams. They seek an intuitive, built-in feature to facilitate efficient connections and improved visual clarity.
